say:2:1331102201:1.text: The undead fell into it, of course! There's talk that the undead will reach out and grab anyone who goes near the well...
say:2:1331102201:1.source_cn: 当然是因为他不小心掉下去的了！我还听说如果有人靠近井边...

say:3:1331102202:1.text: That's... just crap! Even if it's true, I'm not scared as long as the undead's inside the well!

say:4:1331102203:1.text: What if the undead climbs out?
say:4:1331102203:1.source_cn: 那可说不准，万一他爬上来了呢？
